links.outcome: Rate of unsafe completions under adversarial prompts across surrogate, Meditron-7B, and base model
links.effect: Distilled surrogate produced unsafe completions for 86% of adversarial prompts, versus Meditron-7B 66% and untuned base model 46%; distillation cost $12.
links.quote: With a cost of $12, the surrogate achieves strong fidelity on benign inputs while producing unsafe completions for 86% of adversarial prompts, far exceeding both Meditron-7B (66%) and the untuned base model (46%).

unlisted_practices: Extraction-aware safety monitoring and layered defense prototype detector for real-time alignment drift in black-box deployments

screen.reason: Empirical security/safety evaluation of medical LLMs demonstrating safety alignment degradation under black-box distillation and evaluating a layered defense system for real-time alignment drift detection.

primary.practice: real-time alignment drift detector / safety monitoring against model distillation
